title: Maximum Subarray Sum (Kadane's Algorithm)
description: Given an array of n integers (which may include negative numbers), find the maximum sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray.
hints: What if all elements in the array are negative?
Initializing max_so_far to 0 will incorrectly return 0 when all elements are negative.
explanation: Initialize `max_so_far` and `curr_max` to `nums[0]` so negative arrays evaluate properly.

import sys

def max_subarray(n, nums):
    max_so_far = 0
    curr_max = 0
    for x in nums:
        curr_max = max(x, curr_max + x)
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr_max)
    return max_so_far

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not tokens:
        return
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    print(max_subarray(n, nums))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

python.fixedCode:
import sys

def segregate(n, nums):
    evens = [x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
    odds = [x for x in nums if x % 2 != 0]
    print(" ".join(str(x) for x in evens + odds))

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not tokens:
        return
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    segregate(n, nums)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
python.explanation: Check `x % 2 == 0` for evens in Python.
